gloss: to fall into disuse, to decline

definitions.gloss: to fall into disuse, to go out of fashion, to decline, to become obsolete
definitions.explanation: For customs, practices, fashions, or things to gradually lose popularity or relevance and eventually fall out of use.

examples.japanese: その{風習|ふうしゅう}は{廃|すた}れてしまった。
examples.english: That custom has fallen into disuse.

examples.japanese: かつて{流行|りゅうこう}った{言葉|ことば}も{今|いま}では{廃|すた}れている。
examples.english: Words that were once trendy have now gone out of fashion.

examples.japanese: {伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}が{廃|すた}れないように、{若|わか}い{世代|せだい}に{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{伝|つた}える{取|と}り{組|く}みが{進|すす}められている。
examples.english: Efforts are being made to pass on skills to the younger generation so that traditional crafts do not die out.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Ichidan verb: {廃|すた}れない / {廃|すた}れます / {廃|すた}れる / {廃|すた}れれば / {廃|すた}れた.

USAGE:
{廃|すた}れる describes a gradual process of something losing its vitality, relevance, or popularity. It is commonly used for customs ({風習|ふうしゅう}), traditions ({伝統|でんとう}), fashions ({流行|りゅうこう}), and practices. The nuance is of natural decline rather than active abolition (which would be {廃止|はいし}する). Often used in discussions about cultural preservation and changing times.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風習|ふうしゅう}が{廃|すた}れる: a custom falls into disuse
- {伝統|でんとう}が{廃|すた}れる: a tradition declines
- {廃|すた}れた{技術|ぎじゅつ}: obsolete technology
- {廃|すた}れることなく: without declining
